blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court (SC) has dismissed for being moot the petition filed by Leyte 1st District Rep. Ferdinand Martin Romualdez challenging the preliminary investigation conducted by the Office of the Ombudsman regarding his alleged involvement in the flood control projects controversy. Romualdez filed the petition asking the SC to invalidate the Ombudsman’s preliminary investigation, which included applications for a preliminary hold departure order and a freeze order of his accounts, as well as the alleged use of inadmissible evidence. The investigation is in connection with the plunder case against him over alleged kickbacks and fund diversions from 2022 […]...
